decisions.scope: The option conversion pipe supports arrays and Observable sources. Labels, values, disabled state, a
decisions.quote: The option conversion pipe supports arrays and Observable sources. Labels, values, disabled state, and groups can be mapped with `labelProp`, `valueProp`, `disabledProp`, and `groupProp`; inspect the pipe before inventing an option shape. Its defaults use `label`, `value`, `disabled`, and `group`. [K15](sources.md#k15)
decisions.rationale: Exact K15/K14 bytes inspected: mapping/groups and select-owned helper lifecycle; no arbitrary application teardown guarantee.

decisions.scope: The Material select's default `compareWith` uses strict equality. If the model stores an object and
decisions.quote: The Material select's default `compareWith` uses strict equality. If the model stores an object and a reload creates new option objects, check identity or provide an appropriate comparator. Confirm whether the model should contain an ID or an object before changing it. The renderer also handles multiple selection and invokes the configured change callback with field and event. [K14](sources.md#k14)
decisions.rationale: Exact K14/K15 bytes inspected: comparison is separate from mapping, renderer multiple/select-all conditions and callback arguments.

decisions.quote: The selected upstream tests include rendering options and selection; they were read, not run. sections.heading: Common and secondary entry points
sections.rationale: Select claims are drafted where mapped; all unrelated Material coverage remains explicitly pending. No installed admission.

decisions.scope: | Type | Important contract | Evidence |
decisions.quote:
| Type | Important contract | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| input | HTML input kind comes from `props.type`; number has a dedicated template branch. Forwards readonly, required, error matcher, control, attributes, name, placeholder | [K47](sources.md#k47) |
| textarea | Adds rows/cols and autosize/min/max rows; readonly is explicitly bound. Default rows and cols are 1 | [K51](sources.md#k51) |
| select | Options stream, mappings, groups, multiple, compareWith, panelClass, select-all. No readonly input is bound in this renderer | [K14](sources.md#k14), [K15](sources.md#k15) |
| checkbox | Boolean-oriented control; indeterminate display depends on a nullish control value and enabled indeterminate prop. Its own label and required marker interact with wrapper defaults | [K48](sources.md#k48), [K62](sources.md#k62) |
| multicheckbox | Default path produces a Boolean map keyed by option values; `props.type: 'array'` produces selected-value arrays. Choice affects the payload contract | [K49](sources.md#k49), R15 |
| radio | Options use the shared mapping pipe; each option can be disabled. Group focus/keyboard handling differs from an input | [K50](sources.md#k50) |
| toggle | Separate `@ngx-formly/material/toggle` entry point. Binds required, labelPosition, color, control and attributes; own label with wrapper label hidden by default | [K52](sources.md#k52) |
| datepicker | Separate entry point; adapter choice and nested `datepickerOptions` matter | [Material](material.md), [K18](sources.md#k18), [K19](sources.md#k19) |
| slider | Separate entry point with legacy/MDC implementation selection. The MDC variant places the control on `input matSliderThumb` | [K33](sources.md#k33), [K53](sources.md#k53), [K54](sources.md#k54) |
| native-select | Separate entry point; native option values use ngValue and support optgroups. A source readonly binding alone does not establish a functional browser readonly interaction contract | [K55](sources.md#k55) |
decisions.rationale: Outside the bounded select batch; retained for a later Material source review.

decisions.scope: `compareWith` defaults to strict equality. `labelProp`/`valueProp` define mapping, while comparison
decisions.quote: `compareWith` defaults to strict equality. `labelProp`/`valueProp` define mapping, while comparison determines selected-option identity; these are distinct responsibilities. Native-select and mat-select are not interchangeable adapters with identical props. [K14](sources.md#k14), [K15](sources.md#k15), [K55](sources.md#k55)
decisions.rationale: Material equality versus mapping covered; native-select comparison remains outside this batch, not certified as equivalent.

decisions.scope: Select-all flattens groups, excludes disabled options, and caches its value list by the options-arra
decisions.quote: Select-all flattens groups, excludes disabled options, and caches its value list by the options-array reference. Its state calculation compares lengths. For unusual dynamic/partial/stale selections, test behavior rather than assuming semantic set equality or expecting in-place option mutations to invalidate every cache. Replacing the options array is a useful explicit update boundary. [K14](sources.md#k14)
decisions.rationale: Exact K14 bytes inspected: flatten/filter, length-based toggle/state and transformed-options identity cache; no set-equality claim.

decisions.scope: The select reads aria-label and aria-labelledby from props.attributes, with a wrapper-label fallback
decisions.quote: The select reads aria-label and aria-labelledby from props.attributes, with a wrapper-label fallback. Check accessible names when labels are visually hidden. Overlay presentation uses the forwarded panelClass; a field host class is not automatically the overlay panel class. [K14](sources.md#k14)
decisions.rationale: Accessibility and panelClass are valid adjacent topics but deferred to keep this batch bounded.

decisions.scope: 1. **Angular value access:** how programmatic values, user values, touched, and disabled state reach
decisions.quote:
1. **Angular value access:** how programmatic values, user values, touched, and disabled state reach the form control.
2. **Formly type integration:** the field's control, props, hooks, registration and attributes.
3. **Material form-field integration:** error/focus/empty/label behavior and a suitable MatFormFieldControl.

decisions.scope: Passing one does not establish the others. Formly's Material `FieldType` is publicly re-exported fro
decisions.quote: Passing one does not establish the others. Formly's Material `FieldType` is publicly re-exported from `@ngx-formly/material` and bridges the form-field control. In I3512 the maintainer specifically points to this base rather than the core base. Use it for the matching design, while still supplying proper control/value-accessor behavior. R09 exercises a simple matInput custom type; it does not certify composite widgets. [K16](sources.md#k16), [K63](sources.md#k63), [I3512](bug-ledger.md#i3512)
decisions.rationale: Outside the bounded select batch; retained for a later Material source review.

decisions.scope: If a widget already owns its own mat-form-field or is a standalone button/layout, decide whether a F
decisions.quote: If a widget already owns its own mat-form-field or is a standalone button/layout, decide whether a Formly form-field wrapper is appropriate. Avoid double decoration. A composite value should be modeled either as a grouped set of child fields or as an intentional single control with a coherent value accessor; do not silently mix both ownership models. [K31](sources.md#k31), [I3572](bug-ledger.md#i3572)
